notification.primary.subject: Registration required for {{title}}
notification.primary.body:
You have been assigned to {{title}}. External registration is required.

Deadline: {{deadline}} ({{timezone}})
Registration link: {{url}}

Once you have registered, mark it in Timeline.
notification.reminder.subject: Reminder: registration for {{title}}
notification.reminder.body:
A reminder about registration for {{title}}.

Deadline: {{deadline}} ({{timezone}})
Registration link: {{url}}

Once you have registered, mark it in Timeline to stop the reminders.
notification.overdue.subject: The registration deadline for {{title}} has passed
email.verification.subject: Confirm your address in Timeline
email.verification.body:
Hello {{name}},

Confirm your email address to receive event registration reminders:
{{link}}

The link is valid for {{ttl}}. If you did not create an account, simply ignore this message.
email.password_reset.subject: Account recovery in Timeline
email.password_reset.body:
Hello {{name}},

Follow this link to set a new password:
{{link}}

The link is valid for {{ttl}}. After the password changes, every active session is terminated.
If you did not request recovery, simply ignore this message.
email.email_change.subject: Confirm your new address in Timeline
email.email_change.body:
Hello {{name}},

Confirm your new email address:
{{link}}

The link is valid for {{ttl}}. Until it is confirmed, sign-in uses the previous address.
email.invite.subject: Invitation to Timeline
email.invite.body:
Hello,

{{name}} invites you to Timeline, a system for tracking events and registrations.
Follow this link to create an account:
{{link}}

The invitation is valid for {{ttl}}.
